slides.title: Basic Compute Unit

slides.title: Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA)
slides.prompt: What metric does the Horizontal Pod Autoscaler typically monitor to scale Python API pods dynamically?
options: CPU utilization and memory usage limits
slides.correctAnswer: CPU utilization and memory usage limits

slides.title: Kubernetes ConfigMaps
slides.prompt: Fill in the Kubernetes resource used to store non-confidential environment configuration data.

slides.title: Liveness vs Readiness Probes
slides.prompt: What is the purpose of a Readiness Probe in Kubernetes?
options: Determining if a pod is ready to accept user network traffic
Restarting stuck or dead containers automatically
Compiling Python code into C extensions
Scanning source code for security flaws
slides.correctAnswer: Determining if a pod is ready to accept user network traffic
